question: Can deposited whole-lung cell annotations and original mouse identities be recovered without loading large assay arrays?
decision: Qualify original labels and mouse support before the separately frozen RNA resolution-context screen.
strongest_rival: An incorrect serialization transform or barcode/HTO interpretation could assign cells to the wrong state or mouse.
discriminator: Native-R fixture parity, byte-identical unmodified pass-through and fail-closed parsing; later independent joins against original sparse counts.
exposure_record: Published 36-mouse/45311-cell report and source methods are exposed; no newly aggregated target-gene result inspected.
biological_unit: Original source mouse identified by age/day capture plus HTO; pending recovery verification.
nesting_and_overlap: Cells nested in mouse, six mice per age/day capture, different mice at each day. Shared source data are not replication.
population_and_selection: Retain deposited whole-lung annotations and selection for the male young/old PBS/BLM D14/D28/D60 cohort.
contrast: Metadata identity and recoverability only; no gene expression or condition-effect contrast.
endpoint: Recovered metadata table, source class and dimensions, and exact inventory of stripped nonmetadata large numeric payloads.
methods: R XDR v2/v3 stream transform copies all structure and atomic vectors of <=1000000 elements unchanged; strips larger numeric payloads, then native readRDS recovers metadata. Synthetic parity and failure tests precede source execution.
missingness_and_exclusions: No cell exclusion or imputation. Fail if source is not Seurat or metadata is not 45311 unique equal-length rows. Stripped arrays are invalid and never used as expression.
multiplicity: Not applicable to metadata recovery; no effect testing.
precision_basis: Metadata identity and exact parity, not biological precision or sample-size justification.
interpretation_limit: Successful recovery establishes source metadata access only, not mouse independence or biological associations; those require downstream checks.
stop_rule: Stop on unsupported serialization types, long vectors, truncation, excessive nesting, trailing bytes or source/metadata mismatch. Preserve failure and amend prospectively.
amendment_reason: Initial prospective metadata-only recovery; memory limitation prevents an unbounded native whole-object load.
